change_intent: Tighten Account.email from optional to required.
rationale: Compliance review wants every customer record to carry a contact email so we can deliver legally-required notifications. Currently many legacy rows have NULL.

semantic_contract.meaning_before: Account.email is an optional contact handle; many rows have NULL.
semantic_contract.meaning_after: Every Account is guaranteed to carry a non-null contact email.
semantic_contract.justification: Refines the meaning of Account by strengthening an invariant.
invariants: Every Account row has a non-null email.
No new Account can be created without an email.

tests.name: no_null_email_post_migration
tests.assertion: After migration, no Account row has email = NULL.

provenance.author: user://compliance-team
provenance.source_prompt: Tighten Account.email to required for compliance.
